task_title: Landlock filesystem isolation tier for AppArmor-degraded hosts
task_criteria: scripts/landlock-capability-probe.py exists and reports the kernel Landlock ABI per host machine-readably

when the host permits Landlock, the jail denies reads of credential surfaces (dot-ssh, config tokens, other users homes) and denies writes outside the working tree, proven by a denied read returning EACCES
where Landlock cannot enforce, behaviour is unchanged with a loud warning, and no regression in existing unshare/bwrap tests
